backup.production_rule: Seeds booking_rate_policy_versions (1 row, today's card) and a new rate_promotions table (the Anniversary Promotion); four new functions; open_booking_hold_v1 also stamps rate_policy_version_id; the lifecycle event check gains two promotion event types. No stored booking amount changes. Take a fresh backup if this one is more than an hour old at apply time.

forward_verification.name: the_anniversary_promotion_is_on_the_card
forward_verification.query: select exists (select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(public.get_rate_card_v1() -> 'promotions') p where p ->> 'name' = 'Anniversary Promotion' and p ->> 'first_night' = '2026-10-11' and p ->> 'last_night' = '2026-10-17' and (p ->> 'nightly_rate')::numeric = 1543) and position('1929' in public.get_rate_card_v1()::text) = 0

forward_verification.name: the_body_is_the_reviewed_body
forward_verification.query: select md5(prosrc) = '2053a60fe7a1ed34eb9f358fa08c66e3' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.get_rate_card_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: anon_reads_the_card_and_writes_nothing
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('anon','public.get_rate_card_v1(uuid)','EXECUTE') and not has_function_privilege('anon','public.publish_rate_card_v1(numeric,jsonb,date,text,text,numeric,uuid)','EXECUTE') and not has_function_privilege('anon','public.save_rate_promotion_v1(uuid,text,date,date,numeric,text,uuid)','EXECUTE') and not has_function_privilege('anon','public.end_rate_promotion_v1(uuid,text)','EXECUTE') and not has_table_privilege('anon','public.rate_promotions','SELECT') and (select relrowsecurity from pg_class where oid = 'public.rate_promotions'::regclass)

forward_verification.name: one_open_card_version
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 from public.booking_rate_policy_versions where effective_to is null

steps.name: roll_back_the_functions_first
steps.action: Redeploy submit-booking, messenger-concierge and telegram-cassy from their pre-SPEC-34 commits (waves 803e2e6 / 06a8884) and delete rate-card, or they fall back to the seed card and log rate_card_fallback.

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: apply supabase/rollbacks/20260926_rate_card.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh (drops the four functions and rate_promotions, restores open_booking_hold_v1, clears the card versions and their audit events, restores the event check). Export rate_promotions and booking_rate_policy_versions first if Lloyd edited them.

feature_flags.name: sql_before_functions
feature_flags.required_state: Apply before deploying pricing.ts consumers (submit-booking, rate-card, messenger-concierge, telegram-cassy). Until then every function keeps its own copy of the same card, so nothing a guest sees changes at apply time.

compatibility.rehearsal: Rehearsed 2026-09-26 ~08:17Z on a disposable restore of production backup cascade-supabase-20260926T081144Z (prefix cascade-migration-rehearsal-c716b6ad78c6, 0 leftovers). 104 public tables and 129 ledger rows before; migration 1 of 1; forward checks 5/5; pgTAP rate_card.sql 23/23; 105 tables after. The first run failed 17 pgTAP lines on a --no-acl grant (authenticated reading booking_rate_policy_versions); production grants authenticated SELECT on it (read 2026-09-26), and the suite now reads the table as the test owner.
compatibility.evidence: New objects only, plus open_booking_hold_v1 filling a column that already existed (nullable, FK). pgTAP rate_card.sql (23). Functions: pricing.test.ts 5/5 (the SPEC-34 2.2 pins and the submit-booking authority rule).

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
restore_point or verified_at is still empty
